title: WIDGET : Very cool except basal rate color and not "clicable"
body:
The WIDGET is a great addition, tnx :)

It would be better id the basal rate was not black on gray ;)

![Screenshot_20220403-103943_One UI Home.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/161419556-caebc5b1-59cb-43dd-b954-2dca17fc1ea1.jpg)

comments.body: Taping on the Widget doesn't open AAPS :( Would be nice to have that possibility.

If DynISF is selected, we have a n/a when in AAPS the info is present.

![Screenshot_20220403-125145_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/161424198-c332f3f0-8818-4865-829c-803a66258ee2.jpg)

When carbs are required, the texts are too condensed. Could the required carbs be noted on a 2nd line?

![Screenshot_20220403-144115_One UI Home.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/161428640-e9e13c34-aedf-42c5-966c-ff008f2556ae.jpg)
added posibility to extend widget .... are there still any issues?

Hi Milos. The only thing I see FTM is the black on gray text for basals.

Didn't have _x gr carbs needed_ yet, so I don't know how they will show.
